title: Playboy Magazine March 1975 Margot Kidder Kris Kristofferson Vintage
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, March 1975 issue. Cover feature "Ripped Off! A Torrid Nine-Page Pictorial." Also inside: "Country Boy Cum Laude: Kris Kristofferson," Robert Sherrill's "Finds God in Washington," "The Great Pentagon Fighter-Plane Shoot-Out," and "Keeping Cool Through Hard Times."
Complete issue, no missing pages. Cover shows some wear from age — small tears near the spine, light foxing/staining, and a price sticker (see photos). Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
